description: This file contains Makefile definitions for building device images and configurations related to Chromium OS and OnHub devices, including migration info, build steps, device-specific configurations, and external utilities.

methods.name: Device/dsa-migration
methods.description: Defines a migration message for DSA setup, indicating incompatibility between configurations.

methods.name: Build/cros-gpt
methods.description: Creates a partition table for Chrome OS using a temporary file and concatenation.

methods.name: Build/append-kernel-part
methods.description: Appends kernel image data to the final image file.

methods.name: Build/cros-vboot
methods.description: Signs the boot image with Chromium OS's verified boot utility.

methods.name: Device/OnhubImage
methods.description: Defines device-specific parameters for OnHub images, including kernel load address, device tree, images, packages, and build steps.

methods.name: Device/asus_onhub
methods.description: Overrides OnhubImage with ASUS-specific device parameters and configurations.

methods.name: Device/tplink_onhub
methods.description: Overrides OnhubImage with TP-Link-specific device parameters and configurations.
